name: RSS Research Digest
description: Fetch an RSS feed, summarize the useful items, and turn noisy reading into a practical research digest.

assignments.name: topic_lens
assignments.value: AI workflows, automation ideas, local AI, practical productivity systems, and reusable workflow examples

assignments.name: audience
assignments.value: Busy creators, solo builders, consultants, and practical AI learners who want useful things to read without checking every feed manually

assignments.name: digest_goal
assignments.value: Find the most useful ideas, links, and actions from today's feed items so the reader knows what is worth opening, saving, or turning into content/workflows.

assignments.name: fallback_items
assignments.value: 1. n8n shares examples for AI workflow automation. 2. Ollama improves local model management. 3. A creator explains how meeting notes can become SOPs. 4. A newsletter covers practical ways to organize AI research notes.

parameters.jsCode:
const input = { ...$json };

const prompt = [
  'You are creating a practical RSS research digest for a human reader.',
  '',
  'Workflow: GP-WF-003 - RSS Research Digest',
  'Problem it solves: The reader follows too many feeds, blogs, newsletters, and updates to know what is worth opening or saving.',
  'Main task: Turn raw RSS/feed items into a concise research digest with themes, useful links, action ideas, and parked items.',
  '',
  'Input data:',
  JSON.stringify(input, null, 2),
  '',
  'Content principles:',
  '- Practical, clear, and useful.',
  '- Write like a knowledgeable coworker filtering the noise.',
  '- Do not hype the items or pretend every link is important.',
  '- Do not invent URLs, quotes, facts, or claims beyond the provided feed items.',
  '- If an item is thin, say what should be checked before trusting it.',
  '- Focus on what is worth reading, saving, turning into content, or turning into a workflow.',
  '',
  'Return ONLY valid JSON in this exact shape:',
  '{',
  '  "document_title": "Specific digest title",',
  '  "summary": "Plain-English summary of what this digest found.",',
  '  "top_themes": ["Theme 1", "Theme 2", "Theme 3"],',
  '  "must_read_items": [',
  '    {',
  '      "title": "Item title",',
  '      "link": "Item link if provided",',
  '      "why_it_matters": "Why this is worth opening or saving",',
  '      "practical_use": "How the reader could use it"',
  '    }',
  '  ],',
  '  "quick_summaries": [',
  '    { "title": "Item title", "summary": "Two-sentence practical summary" }',
  '  ],',
  '  "workflow_or_content_ideas": ["Idea 1", "Idea 2", "Idea 3"],',
  '  "parked_items": ["Item or idea to save for later"],',
  '  "things_to_verify": ["Claim, link, or topic a human should verify"],',
  '  "cta": "One small next action.",',
  '  "next_steps": ["Practical next step 1", "Practical next step 2", "Practical next step 3"],',
  '  "review_note": "Short reminder about what a human should check before using the digest."',
  '}',
  '',
  'Quality bar:',
  '- Identify 2 to 4 top themes.',
  '- Pick 1 to 3 must-read items, not everything.',
  '- Summarize every parsed feed item briefly.',
  '- Include at least 3 workflow_or_content_ideas.',
  '- Keep it skimmable and useful.',
  '',
  'Final reminder: output JSON only. No Markdown fence. No explanation before or after the JSON.'
].join('\n');

return [{ json: { ...input, prompt } }];
